This plot is rented, so I do not want to spend too much cash on it — if I put manure or buy trees, the owner benefits next year, not me. I will buy one bag of DAP and one small bag of urea from the cooperative if the supply comes in time, because without some fertilizer the harvest on this rented ground is poor. I cannot afford improved seed this year after paying the rent, so I will use seed I saved from last season, and I will not irrigate because there is no water source near this plot. My wife and I will do most of the weeding ourselves, but I will call two or three neighbors for a few days at planting and harvest and pay them with food and a little cash.
